user.title: Set up CurbCharge

station_options.title: Choose nearby stations
station_options.description: CurbCharge checks provider connectivity before creating the entry.

data_description.search_radius: Only public charging stations within this distance are included.
data_description.max_stations: Limit the number of stations and their entities.
data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant refreshes charging station data.

discovery_filters.title: Filter nearby stations
discovery_filters.description: Optionally match NDW stations by their connector groups. Filters apply before the station limit.

data_description.connector_types: Leave empty for any type. A matching connector group with any selected type must also meet the other filters.
data_description.min_power_kw: Optional. A matching connector group must report at least this power.
data_description.require_available: Only include stations when a matching connector group reports available connectors.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant refreshes charging station data.
data_description.search_radius: Only public charging stations within this distance are included.
data_description.max_stations: Limit the number of stations and their entities.
data_description.provider: The data provider used to discover stations and availability.
data_description.include_unknown: Include stations when the provider reports no connector availability.
data_description.connector_types: Leave empty for any type. A matching connector group with any selected type must also meet the other filters.
data_description.min_power_kw: Optional. A matching connector group must report at least this power.
data_description.require_available: Only include stations when a matching connector group reports available connectors.
data_description.favourites: Select charging points by name. Favourites remain available outside the search radius and are added beyond the nearby station limit.
data_description.location_movement_threshold: Minimum distance the selected entity must move before the search location is updated. Set to 0 to disable the threshold.

data_description.enabled: Enable this saved profile for personalized recommendations. Until personalization evaluation is available, existing recommendations remain unchanged.
data_description.connector_type_ids: Choose canonical connector standards. Leave empty to accept any connector type.
data_description.minimum_power_kw: Optional minimum for a matching connector group; use a finite nonnegative value.
data_description.preferred_operators: Enter one provider-qualified reference per line, for example ndw_dot_nl:NLX, eco_movement_be:Example CPO, or nobil_no:Synthetic CPO. NDW IDs and NOBIL names match exactly; Belgium names are trimmed, whitespace-collapsed, and case-insensitive. Saved choices are retained when not nearby.
data_description.excluded_operators: Enter one provider-qualified reference per line using the same format as preferred operators. Matching exclusions are never bypassed by fallback.
data_description.maximum_price: Optional nonnegative decimal amount. Leave blank for no price cap.
data_description.maximum_price_currency: Required with a maximum price; enter a three-letter currency code such as EUR.
data_description.ranking_preset: Choose a fixed ranking objective; custom weights are not supported.
data_description.allow_fallback: Allow eligible non-preferred candidates only when no full match exists.
data_description.unknown_data_policy: Choose whether unknown connector, power, or operator values may enter fallback results. Unknown availability and known hard-constraint failures are never relaxed.

error.invalid_discovery_filters: Enter valid discovery filters. Minimum power must be a finite positive number.
error.invalid_favourites: One or more selected favourites are no longer available. Refresh the options and try again.
error.invalid_personalization_profile: Enter a valid profile. Power and price must be finite and nonnegative, a maximum price needs a three-letter currency, operator references need a supported provider prefix, and an operator cannot be both preferred and excluded.
error.invalid_saved_personalization_profile: The saved personalization profile is malformed or uses an unsupported schema version. Review the fields and save a valid profile to replace it.
